header: This is the PDF of an announcement as the reader sees it inside the announcement's window: a card with the file's name and size, a full-screen button (an icon: the PDF then opens over the page in the same kind of viewer as a circular, with a cross) and a Download button, and the PDF itself shown right there (a frame). An announcement that is ONLY a title and a PDF shows the PDF at once; one that also has body text offers "View here". I always fetch the PDF from our own route (src/app/api/announcements/[id]/file/route.ts); the browser never knows the address of the file in storage.

symbols.name: AnnouncementFile
symbols.sig: export function AnnouncementFile({ id, file, startOpen, onOpenFull, page }: { id: number; file: AnnouncementFileInfo; page?: number | null; startOpen: boolean; onOpenFull: () => void })

params.name: { id, file, startOpen, onOpenFull, page }
params.type: { id: number; file: AnnouncementFileInfo; page?: number | null; startOpen: boolean; onOpenFull: () => void }

behaviours: the card names the file, says PDF and its size, and has a Download link through our own route

the old 'Open' (a link to a new tab) is gone: in its place a button with only an icon, the expand icon (one arrow to the top-right corner, one to the bottom-left: lucide Maximize2), named for screen readers and in a tooltip
when the PDF stands alone the frame is shown at once, with no View-here toggle
when there is body text too, the frame waits for 'View here'
an announcement of only a title and a PDF shows the PDF at once in a wide window, and does not say 'No additional details'
an announcement with body text and a PDF shows the text first, then the PDF card (frame closed), in the usual window
an announcement with no PDF is as it was
one with neither says 'No additional details'
when the caller does not know about a PDF (a search result), nothing is claimed before the window has asked
the window asks for the file's name and size by itself (?info=1) only when the caller left it out
the viewer is a full-screen dialog in the circular viewer's own layer (dark, blurred), above everything (z 400), with a cross named 'Close the PDF' and the announcement's title in its header
it shows the PDF of that announcement from our own route, and takes Escape for itself (data-escape-own)

the PDF fills ALL the room below the header (the first frame of the card is not kept here): the canvas has no padding and the frame is stretched to its four edges with no width limit, no rounded corners, no border and no shadow
the browser's thumbnail panel is closed and the page opens at a fixed 150% zoom (never fit-to-width, which stretched it over a wide screen)

the PDF viewer's own scrollbars are hidden until the pointer is over the frame: two strips in the viewer's background colour, painted over where the bars sit, that fade away on hover of the frame's box (group-hover), never catch the pointer, and leave the toolbar uncovered (the vertical one starts below it)
both frames carry the strips inside a hover group: the card's frame (clipped, rounded box) and the full-screen canvas
a result found inside the PDF opens the window with the PDF shown at once, on that page (no View-here toggle), and says so
with no page the card is as it was (frame closed, View here, fit-to-width, no 'found on page')
the full-screen viewer opens on the page too, still at 150%, thumbnail panel closed
the announcement's window passes the page on: body text, then the PDF card with its frame on that page
a PDF that was read says it is searchable inside, with its pages and how they were read, and has no button
a PDF taken wholly from its own text does not mention AI
a PDF that could not be read says why and offers 'Index again'
a PDF not prepared yet says that only its title is searchable and offers the same button; without the handler there is no button
a text that could not be indexed is told even where there is no PDF, with the button; an announcement with no PDF and a fine text shows nothing
the manager's card shows that state under the PDF chip, and the button is off while something is running
on the search results an announcement found inside its PDF says 'In the PDF, page N' with the passage, and a click opens the window on that page
after a publish or edit the manager reads what happened to the PDF's reading (a failure is a warning, the announcement is saved); 'Read it again' calls the reindex operation
the layer is ONE component, shared: by default it is the circular viewer's own (z 150, cross named 'Close viewer')
the circular viewer now draws its layer with that shared component (it has no layer markup of its own any more) and keeps its page scroller and match markers

the PDF viewer is drawn in a portal on <body>, closes on Escape in the capture phase (so neither TopBar nor the search window closes behind it), locks the page's scrolling, and a click in it does not reach the announcement's window
the full-screen button only asks the window to open the viewer (the window owns it, so the button, the linked words and the title open the same one); the window shows it, with its own title
on the home page's card the title text shows the hand cursor when the card opens something, and the plain cursor only when it does not
with a body and a PDF, the linked words are drawn as a link that opens the PDF (a button for the keyboard and screen readers, no address), and the body is wired for click and keys
with body text, the title is plain text (not a link), and the PDF card is under the text
when the announcement is known to have no PDF, linked words are plain words (no link, the words stay)
an announcement that is only a title and a PDF keeps a PLAIN title (no link, no button in the heading, no blue underline): the PDF opens full screen only by the card's expand button, which is there
an announcement with no PDF has a plain title
a click, or Enter or Space, on words with the marker opens the PDF; nothing opens when the announcement has no PDF; the viewer is mounted only when there is a PDF
the picker says PDF is optional, one PDF up to 10 MB, a title and a PDF alone is enough; has an accessible file input for PDFs only
a chosen file shows its name and size and can be taken off
when editing an announcement that has a PDF, the picker shows it with 'Remove this PDF' and offers to replace it
a PDF marked for removal says it will be removed when you update, and offers to keep it
a new file chosen over an existing PDF says it replaces it
a problem with the file is shown as an alert
a card of the manager marks an announcement that has a PDF (name and size), and one that has none carries no mark
the panel sends a form (not JSON) only when a PDF is chosen or one is to be removed; a plain publish and edit stay JSON
the form call waits two minutes (a PDF is slow to send), the picker checks name, emptiness and size before anything is sent, and the PDF state is cleared on publish, update and cancel
the picker sits under the content editor in the publish form
both lists of the home page open an announcement that has only a PDF (they opened only those with body text), and mark it with a PDF icon
